description: Conformance vectors for C2PA Appendix A.8 unstructured-text embedding (Unicode variation selectors). Format-neutral. Values are derived from the specification; the c2pa-text reference library was used only as a cross-check, and does not define correctness here.

wrapper.layout: marker U+FEFF, then the variation-selector encoding of magic(8) + version(1) + big-endian length(4) + payload + optional padding

payload.note: A fixed placeholder, not a signed Manifest Store. These vectors exercise the transport and detection layer.

deterministicPadding.note: The specification fixes both the target length and the padding byte values, so compliant generators emit byte-identical wrappers for the same manifest. This is the most divergence-prone part of A.8.
deterministicPadding.padding_note: a bytes of 0x00 (3-byte selectors) followed by b bytes of 0x10 (4-byte selectors): 1*3 + 2*4 = 11

hardBinding.note: Byte offsets are into the asset as stored, before NFC normalization. The excluded range covers the U+FEFF marker together with the variation-selector run, including any trailing padding.
hardBinding.visible_text: This sentence carries an invisible C2PA text manifest wrapper at its end.
hardBinding.covered_note: Remove the exclusion range first, then normalize the remainder to NFC, then hash. The visible text here is already NFC, so the covered bytes are the 73 bytes above.
